channel.title: PIXTiel
channel.description: Engineering notes from building PIXTiel, a local multi-agent coding workspace.

item.title: Introducing PIXTiel 1.0
item.description: A local workspace where every task is a card, every card is a git worktree, and the agent that runs it is yours to pick. Here is what ships in the first release.
item.author: Tiến Nguyễn

item.title: One git worktree per card
item.description: Parallel agents in one checkout corrupt each other's work. The fix is boring and load-bearing: give every card its own worktree, lock its base ref, and checkpoint every turn.
item.author: Tiến Nguyễn

item.title: Rate limits are a scheduling problem
item.description: The 5-hour cap is not an error to surface — it is a resource window to schedule around. How seats, subagent seats and same-seat recovery keep long tasks alive.
item.author: Tiến Nguyễn
